acceptanceCriteria: depsource verifies at least one JS/TS package manager's lockfile integrity hash against local node_modules content before citing it, and abstains with a named reason otherwise.
Fixtures cover a verified package, an absent package and a hash mismatch.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner-requested gap analysis of Corvint against competing context tools, current standards and a trial on a local clone of MeVille (TypeScript, about 4,600 tracked files). `corvint depsource` verifies a Go module's cached source against go.sum and abstains otherwise (internal/depsource). Agents hallucinate third-party APIs; Context7 and Tessl answer that over the network. The same offline, pin-verified approach can cover npm/pnpm lockfiles with node_modules type declarations and Python lockfiles with site-packages, keeping invariant 7.
title: depsource: extend lockfile-pinned third-party API evidence beyond Go modules
